remarks: Why rent when you can own? Enjoy the convenience of downtown Stamford and so close to everything! Wonderful 8th floor penthouse with views including sunsets and western exposure. Newer flooring in living room, dining room and bedroom. Newly painted July 2025. Granite counters and breakfast bar. Owner currently rents two parking spaces (tandem) in the buildings covered and secure parking garage, these same spaces can be rented by the next owner. Laundry is in the unit. Fitness center is in the building and included in the common charges. Newer HVAC system in this unit which was paid for by owner. Private storage area is optional. Unit is very efficient to operate. Wonderful use of space and open kitchen, living and dining room. Common deck area has tables, chairs and grills to use. Pet friendly 2 Pets dog/cat 75lbs.

facts.laundryLoc: In unit washer and dryer, kitchen area
